integrity: The infinite statement is proved by exact modular remainder analysis. An embedded verifier independently replays Hamilton allocation with integer and Fraction arithmetic over 489 primitive test cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only primitive equal-pair triples \((a,a,c)\) and only consecutive apportionments whose cutoff is unique; it does not give the full random-tie or arbitrary-rational formula.
title: Tie-independent Alabama losses for equal-pair rational populations
